import json, re
s = open('prev.svg').read()
# drop exp-20's red SWA additions (everything appended after the last original element)
cut = s.index("<ellipse cx='672' cy='552'")
s = s[:cut] + '</svg>'
F = "font-family='Palatino,Georgia,serif'"
def rep(old, new):
    global s
    assert old in s, old
    s = s.replace(old, new)
rep('8 epochs · MixStyle is identity at export', 'weights averaged over epochs 5–8 · MixStyle off at export')
rep('only which weights fly changed · graph, size (31.7 MB), decode and gate identical to exp 19',
    'only the training schedule changed · graph, size (31.7 MB), decode and gate identical to exp 20')
R, A = '#8c2f1f', '#8a6a1e'
g = []
x0, y0, cw, ch = 604, 538, 12, 14
for i in range(9):
    x = x0 + i * cw
    if i == 0:
        g.append(f"<rect x='{x}' y='{y0}' width='{cw}' height='{ch}' fill='{R}' fill-opacity='.12' stroke='{R}' stroke-width='1.2'/>")
    else:
        op = ".12" if i >= 5 else "0"
        g.append(f"<rect x='{x}' y='{y0}' width='{cw}' height='{ch}' fill='{A}' fill-opacity='{op}' stroke='{A}' stroke-width='.9'/>")
    col = R if i == 0 else A
    g.append(f"<text x='{x+cw/2}' y='{y0+ch+11}' {F} font-size='8' fill='{col}' text-anchor='middle'>{i}</text>")
# snowflake-free 'held still' marker: two short bars over cell 0
cx = x0 + cw / 2
g.append(f"<text x='{x0+54}' y='{y0-6}' {F} font-size='8.5' fill='{A}' font-style='italic' text-anchor='middle'>epochs</text>")
g.append(f"<text x='{x0+54}' y='{y0+ch+26}' {F} font-size='8.5' fill='{A}' font-style='italic' text-anchor='middle'>fine-tune 1–8 as before</text>")
g.append(f"<text x='{x0+54}' y='{y0+ch+38}' {F} font-size='8.5' fill='{R}' font-style='italic' text-anchor='middle'>0 = head-only probe</text>")
# red leader from epoch-0 cell up to trunk B caption
g.append(f"<path d='M {cx},{y0} V 505 H 462 V 492' fill='none' stroke='{R}' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='2 4'/>")
tx = 736
rows = [(534, 10, 600, False, 'NEW — probe first, then fine-tune (LP-FT)'),
        (547, 9.5, 400, False, 'extra epoch 0: trunks A, B held still —'),
        (560, 9.5, 400, False, 'weights and BN stats stay ImageNet’s;'),
        (573, 9.5, 400, False, 'only lifts, prototypes, offset head train'),
        (588, 9.5, 400, True, 'the random head cannot distort borrowed eyes')]
for y, sz, w, it, t in rows:
    st = " font-style='italic'" if it else ''
    g.append(f"<text x='{tx}' y='{y}' {F} font-size='{sz}' fill='{R}' font-weight='{w}' text-anchor='start'{st}>{t}</text>")
s = s.replace('</svg>', ''.join(g) + '</svg>')
open('fig.svg', 'w').write(s)
json.dump({'architecture_svg': s}, open('figure.json', 'w'))
EOF

result:
The figure for experiment 21 is written to `runs/20261102_030305_experiment21/figure.json`. figcheck prints PASS, and I rendered it and checked the picture: no collisions, nothing cut off, and input and output sit level on the centre line (H = 620).

- **Starting point:** I reused experiment 20's figure, because the graph that flies hasn't changed (the design leaves `model/model.py` untouched). The inference path is the same two EfficientNet-B0 trunks → cosine tile match → averaged belief → pooled 3×3 centroid → confidence = min(mA, mB).
- **What's red now:** only the head-only warm-up. A 9-cell epoch strip has cell 0 in red ("0 = head-only probe") and epochs 1–8 in the training colour, with 5–8 tinted where the weights are averaged. A red dashed L-shaped line runs from cell 0 up to trunk B. Next to it, red notes say the trunks stay still in epoch 0, with ImageNet weights and BatchNorm statistics frozen, and only the lifts, prototypes and offset head train.
- **What changed back to the training colour:** experiment 20's red weight-averaging (SWA) element. It isn't new in this experiment, so it's now one line in the "unchanged" training notes.
- **Footer:** now reads "only the training schedule changed · … identical to exp 20".

The script that builds the figure (`mkfig.py`) and the preview PNG (`fig.png`) are in the same run folder. I didn't edit any other file.
